newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Dor Energy seeks foreign partner.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Dor Energy seeks foreign partner.

text.p: Israel's Dankner Group is seeking a strategic partnership with a foreign company for its Dor Energy Ltd subsidiary, Dankner chairman Shmuel Dankner said on Monday.

Dankner would not comment on Israeli press reports that the company was in talks with three companies, including Caltex Petroleum Corp, jointly owned by Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc, for the sale of up to 50 percent of Dor.
Dor and Caltex together won a tender last year to supply part of Israel's jet fuel market.
"I have no comment other than to say the reports are not accurate," Dankner told Reuters.
"We are interested in cooperating with a foreign company," he said. "There is nothing more defined."
Dankner owns 100 percent of Dor, having purchased several months ago the shares held by Shamrock Holdings, the investment vehicle of the Roy Disney family.
"We are not looking to sell these shares," Dankner said.
Dor Energy, established in 1988, controls about 18 percent of Israel's fuel market.
Dankner is one of Israel's leading privately owned concerns with interests in energy, chemicals, petrochemicals, plastics, telecommunications and real estate.
